name: Manifold
definition: A smooth space that locally admits a system of real-valued coordinates.

name: Worldline
definition: A curve through spacetime, labelled by a parameter, that records an object’s history.

name: Local coordinates
definition: The real-valued components assigned to a point by a coordinate chart.

name: Tangent space
definition: The vector space of tangent directions to a manifold at a point.

name: Cotangent space
definition: The dual of the tangent space at a point, consisting of linear maps from tangent vectors to scalars.

name: Covector components
definition: The coefficients of a covector in a chosen dual basis.

name: Spacetime indices
definition: Indices that label spacetime coordinate directions.

name: Coordinate-transition Jacobian
definition: The matrix of first partial derivatives that relates two coordinate charts on their overlap.

name: Coordinate chart
definition: A map that assigns a tuple of real coordinates to the points in an open part of a manifold.

name: Chart domain
definition: The open part of a manifold on which a particular chart is defined.

name: Manifold dimension
definition: The number of independent local coordinates at each point of the manifold.

name: Real coordinate space
definition: The space of ordered tuples of n real numbers.

name: Temperature field
definition: A scalar field assigning a temperature to each point of the survey surface.

name: Gaussian curvature
definition: A scalar describing the intrinsic curvature of the survey surface at each point.

name: Growth vector field
definition: A tangent vector field giving the direction and rate of growth on the survey surface.

name: Scalar differential
definition: The covector that maps each tangent vector to the corresponding directional derivative of a scalar field.

name: Directional derivative
definition: The rate of change of a scalar field along the tangent vector v.

name: Coordinate tangent basis
definition: The basis of tangent vectors that differentiate with respect to the local coordinates.

name: Coordinate dual basis
definition: The covector basis whose elements read off the components of a tangent vector in the coordinate tangent basis.

name: Kronecker delta
definition: The component that equals one when its two indices agree and zero otherwise.

name: Covector
definition: A linear map from tangent vectors at a point to scalars.

name: Metric lowering map
definition: The covector that takes a tangent vector w to its metric pairing with v.
